title: Toggle All
description: This Mod Adds a Key bind to toggle everything like scoreboard chat full bright and much more
body:
Toggle All is a lightweight client-side mod that lets you toggle multiple visual and quality-of-life features in Minecraft like scoreboard chat fullbright and much more with ease.

### Toggle All allows you to enable or disable useful features instantly, such as:
- Full Bright
- Background Blur
- Chat
- Scoreboard and Much More

### This Was Made For the Purpose of
Enhancing visuals while recording or streaming
Improving UI appearance
This mod is designed to stay simple and efficient while giving players more control over the visuals.
